'''Uublu''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] who worked as a medic during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and accompanied [[Strike Force Cularin]] on their [[Mission to the Ando system|mission]] to the [[Ando system/Legends|Ando system]].
